transient_failures: Retry with bounded backoff; retain unresolved failures after the attempt budget. Do not classify transient failures as permanently unavailable.
point_in_time: Keep observation, publication, revision and retrieval dates distinct. Revised data and current snapshots do not prove historical public availability.
completion: A run may finish with documented gaps. Report collected, partial, unavailable and unaudited scopes separately; never report gap acceptance as complete historical coverage.

checkup_reporting.duration_basis: consecutive calendar time in explicit [start,end) coverage intervals; merge adjacent gaps within the same source/dataset/scope
